links.outcome: Dosimetric difference between sCT and CT plans in retrospective commissioning cohort
links.effect: Mean dose difference to targets within ±0.7%; OAR differences within ±1.3% on regridded images, up to -4.2% for chiasma D2% at original voxel size; gamma 1%/1mm 93.6%.
links.quote: Dosimetric outcomes in both commissioning and validation stages confirmed sCT's equivalence to CT.

links.outcome: Prospective validation of sCT dosimetric performance in clinical use
links.effect: Validation cohort (30 patients) gamma passing rates 96.6%/99.9%/100% at 1%/1mm, 2%/2mm, 3%/3mm; target mean dose differences within ±0.7%.
links.quote: Mean dose difference to target structures was found to be within ± 0.7 % regardless of image resolution and cohort.

unlisted_practices: Establishing QA guidelines for MR-only radiotherapy workflow based on commissioning results
Regridding images to a common voxel size before dose comparison

screen.reason: The study evaluates the clinical implementation and commissioning-to-prospective validation process, including establishing a clinical quality assurance (QA) protocol for an AI-based synthetic CT tool.

primary.practice: clinical commissioning and QA guidelines establishment
